title: automobile/ownership_history
description: One row per period during which one owner held one vehicle. The chain of custody. Each row is one owner's tenure, so a vehicle with three previous keepers has four rows. Only the most recent has an empty end date.

vehicle_id.description: Which car changed hands. Ordering this table by vehicle and start date reconstructs the full ownership chain.

owner_id.description: Who held it during this period. The same person can appear against several vehicles.

owned_from.description: Date this keeper took possession. For the first owner this equals the vehicle's registration date.

owned_until.description: Date they sold it on, or empty for the current keeper. Exactly one row per vehicle has this empty, which makes it the way to find who owns a car now.

purchase_price.description: What this keeper paid, in euros, reflecting the vehicle's depreciated value at the time. Empty for about 15% of transfers where no price was recorded, such as an inheritance or a family transfer.
